statement: The function returns a result r such that: (1) len(r) = len(nums); (2) for every integer v, the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(r) and r[i] = v equals the number of indices j with 0 <= j < len(nums) and nums[j] = v; (3) there exists an integer k with 0 <= k <= len(r) such that every r[i] with 0 <= i < k satisfies r[i] mod 2 = 0, and every r[i] with k <= i < len(r) satisfies r[i] mod 2 = 1.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 5000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 5000.
